correctness.rationale: Exact radial Fock matrix and isolated vacuum gap make simple-eigenvalue perturbation applicable. The first and second boundary derivatives, including the energy-constraint term, yield the coefficient \(d_n=1-(s^n/n!)/\sum_{j=1}^n s^j/j!\). The strict ordering uses exact falling-factorial monotonicity; the large-area law follows from a dominated geometric ratio and Poisson local CLT. A freshly executed standalone checker passed 249 finite/high-precision corroborations; infinity claims rest on proof, not data.

value.rationale: At the natural Faber–Krahn extremal disk the complete Hessian of the optimized Gaussian time-frequency localization norm is a motivated structural invariant. The result identifies exactly the translation nullspace, the sharp least-stable second harmonic, and every higher angular response. The area-to-mode transition and Poisson Gaussian-edge profile quantify a nontrivial two-scale behavior absent from the general norm/stability inequalities.
